title: Physical Gift Card End-to-End Purchase, Barcode Assignment, and POS Sync
persona: Retail Customer (Desktop), Fulfillment Employee (Desktop), Admin Auditor

scenarios.name: Physical Gift Card Purchase to POS Barcode Activation

steps.text: Customer selects Physical Gift Card with customized design amount
Customer completes checkout with Credit Card and captures order reference
Fulfillment employee opens order in Picking screen
Fulfillment employee scans and binds dynamic 12-digit barcode into Item Info drawer
Fulfillment employee marks order Ready and performs Handover
Customer navigates to Gift Cards tab and confirms newly bound physical card appears in Active Cards list
